# CoachEcho Privacy Policy

_Effective October 1, 2026_

CoachEcho is part of Core Hermit, a family of private, on-device apps. It is built to work without collecting your data. This policy explains what happens to information when you use CoachEcho on iPhone and Apple Watch.

## The short version
- We do **not** collect, store, sell, or share your personal data.
- There are **no accounts, no ads, no analytics, and no tracking**.
- Recordings, transcripts, notes, player names, and reports are stored **on your device** and stay there unless you choose to export or share them.

## Information stored on your device
CoachEcho stores the following only in its own storage on your iPhone:
- audio recordings of your sessions;
- transcripts and their timestamps;
- coach notes, session details, and the people (players) you add, such as names and groups;
- generated coaching reports and their review status;
- your settings.

We cannot access any of it. You can delete sessions and people in the app, and deleting the app removes everything. CoachEcho's recordings folder is also visible to you in the Files app, so you can copy or remove files yourself. Depending on your device settings, iOS may include this data in your own iCloud or device backups, which are governed by Apple.

## Speech recognition
Recordings are transcribed with Apple's Speech framework. **On-Device Recognition is on by default**, so audio is transcribed on your iPhone and never leaves it. If you turn this setting off, or choose a language your iPhone can't transcribe on-device, iOS may send the audio to Apple to transcribe it. Apple handles that audio under its own privacy policy (https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/), and we never receive it.

## AI processing
Coaching reports, summaries, and answers in the session chat are generated **on your iPhone** with Apple's on-device Foundation Models (Apple Intelligence). CoachEcho does not use Apple's Private Cloud Compute or any other server-based AI model. Counts and trends are calculated by the app itself, not by an AI model.

## Apple Watch
If you use the Watch app, recording controls and any audio recorded on the Watch are sent directly between your Watch and your iPhone using Apple's Watch Connectivity. They are not sent to us or to any server.

## Sharing and exports
CoachEcho only shares something when you ask it to: for example, when you export audio, transcripts, or reports, or create a backup file. You choose where it goes (such as Messages, Mail, or Files), and that destination's own privacy terms apply. Backup files you protect with a password are encrypted on your device; we can't recover a forgotten password.

## Recording other people
You are responsible for having permission to record the people in your sessions, and for following the recording and privacy laws where you coach. Some places require everyone's consent. When players are children, get consent from a parent or guardian.

## Network connections
CoachEcho doesn't connect to any server of ours. The only network use is the optional Apple speech recognition described above, and links you tap (such as this policy), which open in your browser.

## Contacting us
If you email us, we receive only what you choose to include, plus your email address. We use it only to reply to you and to improve the app, and we don't share it.

## Children
CoachEcho is a tool for coaches. It is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children. Information about players that a coach enters stays on the coach's device.

## Your rights
Because we don't collect personal data, we hold no personal data about you to access, correct, or delete. All of your data is under your control on your device. If you have questions, contact us.

## Changes
If this policy changes, we'll update the effective date and publish the new version in the app and at https://corehermit.github.io/coachecho/privacy/.
